exports.notes: Read-only local preview. No MongoDB writes. Exports reviewed LOC source records and second v2 draft criterion claims for inspection before production approval.

criterion_mapping.notes: Preview the unreviewed LOC mapping v2 draft2 against freshly extracted reviewed LOC XML. Draft claims are exported for inspection but are not persisted to the production registry.

sources.notes: Fresh reviewed extraction only. Exact factor labels are required; arbitrary prose mentioning factor names cannot create sustainability fields. Documentation is retained as supporting Disclosure evidence rather than an eighth factor.
